question.text: Nidhi is organizing the AGM for a company where e-voting is mandatory. The AGM is being conducted electronically. What type of business can be transacted at this electronic AGM?

answer.text: All ordinary and special business without any restriction
Ordinary business and only special business considered unavoidable by the board
Only ordinary business items; no special business is permitted
Only business approved by SEBI in advance

explanation.text: The Logic: For an electronic AGM, the workbook permits ordinary business to be transacted and, other than ordinary business, only such special business as is considered unavoidable by the board. The Trap: Saying that "only unavoidable special business" can be transacted is incomplete because it omits ordinary business. Saying "all ordinary and special business without any restriction" is too wide because special business is restricted to items that are unavoidable. Note: The rule that ordinary business and only unavoidable special business (considered unavoidable by the board) may be transacted at an electronic AGM is set out on page 160 of the NISM-Series-II-A Registrars and Transfer Agents (Corporate) Certification Examination workbook (October 2025).
